notes.title: 🌸 Plum Road Tea Dream – Demo Out Now! 🌸
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We’re so excited to share that the [b]Prologue [/b]of Plum Road Tea Dream is [b]available now[/b] to play as a free demo on Steam![/p][p]Released as part of the [b]Six One Indie Showcase[/b], this special preview invites you to step into a world of rest, healing, and transformation.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206340/Plum_Road_Tea_Dream/" style="button"]Play the Prologue on Steam[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QncfsZr_fxQ" style="button"]Watch the Six One Indie Showcase[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]🍵 About the Game[/h3][p]Plum Road Tea Dream is an introspective, narrative-driven experience where you follow the story of S., a queer person of color navigating pain and joy through grief. Explore seven immersive sanctuaries, craft animistic gods using a futuristic machine, and search for the Sword of Sadness in a world where emotion is power and rest is resistance.[/p][p][/p][h3]🧡 We Want to Hear from You[/h3][p]This demo is just the beginning—and we’d love your thoughts![/p][p]After playing, please let us know what resonated with you, what you’re curious about, or anything else you'd like to share.[/p][p]Your feedback will help shape the journey ahead.[/p][p][/p][p][i]💭 Wishlist Plum Road Tea Dream on Steam[/i][/p][p][i]🗣️ Tell your friends, post your impressions, or tag us with your thoughts[/i][/p][p][i]🌈 Thank you for dreaming with us.[/i][/p][p][/p]
